criterion: These three objectives require finite benchmark fields, not a subjective hotel-quality judgment. Select the unique hotel under the already frozen initial-state rules. Require an actual user-facing recommendation/statement naming that hotel, its exact literal address when requested, and unambiguous rating and minimum price or price-range assertions as requested. Check every explicit contradictory assertion about those requested fields. Keep original action/negative-effect predicates. Open-ended wording that cannot be attributed uniquely remains UNKNOWN.
positive: All independently derived requested field assertions are present and correct in a clear labeled table/list or explicit declarative answer, and required accepted actions are satisfied.
negative: Any explicit wrong required rating/minimum/range/address, missing requested name or clearly absent mandatory output field is FALSE when absence is established from the complete retained answer. Incorrect extra bookings/events/email effects remain FALSE.
abstention: Ambiguous attribution, multiple conflicting hotel recommendations, unstated fields that cannot be uniquely interpreted, semantic paraphrases of addresses, or missing counterfactual final answers remain UNKNOWN.
limits: No subjective review score, beauty/quality proxy, human reviewer or working external reservation is inferred. The original text and first-pass action outcomes are outcome-aware; this is neither blind nor preregistered.
preservation: Only saved original observations are used; no original data/labels/analyzer/manuscript changes. Existing year/read/postal/reset/recipe/summary barriers remain.
